raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Delivery batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) sent merchant_id as 'M-0102'-style strings instead of plain integers like '102'. The integer cast in silver_transactions fails on these values. The 80 distinct values are 40 numeric plus 40 prefixed, with max 'M-0139', which matches the 40 merchants 100-139 in raw_merchants. So 'M-0NNN' is the same merchant id in a new format, and stripping the 'M-' prefix and leading zeros recovers it.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.83, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(CASE WHEN regexp_matches(trim(merchant_id), '^M-[0-9]+$') THEN regexp_replace(trim(merchant_id), '^M-0*', '') ELSE trim(merchant_id) END AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
